title: GenAI / AI Engineer Interview Prep
summary: Convert roadmap knowledge into interview performance through scenarios, system design, debugging cases, trade-off reasoning and project defense.
outcome: Reason like an AI engineer under interview conditions: explain trade-offs, debug production issues and defend decisions.

project.title: Full Mock GenAI Interview Loop
deliverables: Round 1: solve six rapid production scenarios (RAG accuracy drop, costly agent loop, doubled provider latency, fine-tune regression, prompt that doubles cost, retriever failing on real queries)
Round 2: turn an ambiguous product brief into a defended architecture, from requirements to evals and monitoring
Round 3: present one portfolio project and handle deepening follow-ups on alternatives, cost, failures, evals and scaling
Record or have someone score each round and write down the weakest answers to revisit

topics.d: From theory toward system design, debugging and production scenarios.
Find which roadmap areas a JD actually tests.

topics.t: AI Engineer vs GenAI DS vs DS
topics.d: Roles differ by emphasis, not discipline.

Capability, cost, latency, control, privacy and ops burden.

modules.outcome: Prioritize preparation and position your skills for the target role.
